title: Quasi-identifier linking through health data attributes
description: Calorie intake, meals, and weight entries can serve as quasi-identifiers that, when combined, may uniquely identify an individual within a specific context (e.g., same weight, similar meal patterns, and calorie intake in a small user group).
assumptions: The data is not sufficiently anonymized and the user population is small enough that quasi-identifiers become unique.
